text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf seems to be the name on everybody's lips, but she only comes second in the fan poll.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Resolving to deliver a performance that will convince the holdouts of her strength, the two of us leave the waiting room to face the Arima Kinen.
